title: Cyrillic Script Recognition & Shared Consonants

listeningTarget.genre: Recitation of alphabet letter sounds

targetSkills: Locating basic characters on Mongolian keyboard

spokenProductionTarget.genre: Oral phoneme reproduction

unitOutcome: Learners accurately decode and transcribe initial Cyrillic letters, correctly identifying false friends like В, Н, Р, and Х.
